edit.statement: 'Is an ancestor of' is not transitive: a chain of ancestry alone no longer makes the first person an ancestor of the last.
edit.subject: ancestor_of
edit.original: 'Is an ancestor of' is transitive: an ancestor of an ancestor is also an ancestor.
edit.scope: Ancestry by descent between people; only the transitivity of the relation changes.
